subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Jacob's Ladder
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Jacob's Ladder.

hook.text: Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching heaven with angels going up and down. God spoke from the top.

buildup.text: The ladder connects Earth and heaven directly. It's an axis mundi made of rungs—climbable, practical.

discovery.text: Mesopotamian ziggurats were physical versions of Jacob's ladder—stepped towers where priests ascended toward gods.

twist.text: The ladder implies effort. Unlike a tree you climb around, a ladder demands one rung at a time. Ascent is work.

climax.text: Jacob's ladder influenced monasticism, corporate metaphors, and game design. The vertical climb defines progress.

punchline.text: One rung at a time. Heaven is high.

quiz.question: What did Jacob see in his dream?
options: A ladder with angels going up and down
